Workshop Attire: Maina wears the standard beige workshop coveralls common among U.A.'s Support Department students. These coveralls are practical, with plenty of pockets and straps for holding tools and gadgets.
Civilian Clothes: Outside of her workshop attire, Maina likely dresses in simple, comfortable clothes that don’t draw much attention. She might favor neutral colors and modest styles, like long skirts, sweaters, and blouses.

entries.name: Chikuchi Togeike
entries.content:
Age: 16-17
Height: Approximately 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: Dark
Eye Color: Dark
Quirk: Low-Tier Quirk - As a student in the General Education department, Chikuchi likely doesn’t have a combat-oriented Quirk.

Personality: Chikuchi is likely introverted, with a serious and somewhat sullen demeanor. Despite her seemingly cold exterior, she could be thoughtful and empathetic towards those who take the time to know her.

Appearance: Chikuchi has dark hair styled into low, curved pigtails, with ear-length bangs that arch slightly upward before coming down. Her thin, stern-looking eyes and notable lower eyelashes contribute to her often sullen expression. She has an average build, not particularly athletic, reflecting her more academic focus.

School Uniform: Chikuchi wears the standard U.A. school uniform, which she likely keeps in good condition, reflecting her disciplined nature.
Civilian Clothes: Chikuchi’s civilian wardrobe likely mirrors her serious personality, with simple, muted clothing choices.

entries.name: Yuyu Haya
entries.content:
Age: 18
Height: 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: Reddish (Dyed)
Eye Color: Red-brown
Quirk: Unnamed Electric Arrow Quirk - Yuyu can generate and fire arrows made of electricity, which she can control to some extent.

Personality: Yuyu is likely laid-back and nonchalant, reflected in her slightly disheveled appearance. She has a rebellious streak, not caring much for strict rules or formalities, but she’s still serious about her role as a hero.

Appearance: Yuyu has short, cropped hair that has been dyed a reddish color, matching her red-brown eyes. Her hairstyle, combined with her several ear piercings, gives her a distinctive, slightly edgy look.

Hero Outfit: Yuyu’s hero costume consists of a black, tight-fitting suit that allows for easy movement and is likely insulated to handle her electricity-based Quirk.
Civilian Clothes: Outside of her hero duties, Yuyu’s clothing style is likely casual and slightly rebellious. She might wear oversized jackets, ripped jeans, and graphic tees, reflecting her laid-back and independent personality.

entries.name: Nejire Hado
entries.content:
Quirk: Wave Motion - Nejire can convert her vitality into energy, which she then releases as powerful spiral shockwaves. These waves are highly destructive but move in a slow, spiraling pattern, making them difficult to control and less effective at long range.

Personality: Nejire is bubbly, curious, and full of energy. She’s extremely inquisitive, often asking rapid-fire questions about things that interest her, particularly other people’s Quirks. Her excitement and enthusiasm are infectious, making her well-liked by her peers.

Real Age: 18-19
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 164 cm (5'5")
Hair Color: Light blue with a hint of lavender
Eye Color: Gold
General Appearance: Nejire has long, wavy hair that reaches down to her knees, often styled in loose, flowing waves. She has a slender yet toned build, typical of an experienced hero.

Hero Outfit: Nejire’s hero costume is a blue bodysuit with white and gold accents, designed to withstand the energy output of her Quirk.
Civilian Clothes: Nejire prefers bright, colorful clothing that matches her outgoing personality. She often wears flowy dresses, skirts, and cute accessories, with a preference for pastel colors.

entries.name: Nemuri Kayama
entries.content:
Quirk: Somnambulist - Nemuri can release a sleep-inducing aroma from her skin. The effectiveness of the aroma depends on the target’s gender and proximity, with men generally being more susceptible.

Personality: Nemuri is flamboyant and confident, often leaning towards the risqué. She’s a natural flirt and isn’t afraid to use her charm to her advantage. Highly intelligent, caring, and takes her responsibilities as a hero and teacher seriously.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Twenties
Height: 175 cm (5'9")
Hair Color: Dark purple
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Nemuri has long, wavy dark purple hair that falls down her back, with bangs framing her face. Her blue eyes are sharp and seductive, often emphasized with dark eyeliner. She has a voluptuous figure, which she accentuates with her hero costume.

Hero Outfit: Nemuri’s hero costume is a provocative black and white dominatrix-style bodysuit with a deep neckline, thigh-high boots, and a mask that covers her eyes.
Civilian Clothes: Nemuri’s civilian wardrobe often features bold, form-fitting outfits. She’s likely to wear dresses or skirts with heels, though she also enjoys more casual attire when off-duty.

entries.name: Emi Fukukado
entries.content:
Quirk: Outburst - Emi can force others to laugh uncontrollably, which weakens their ability to think and act, making them vulnerable in combat.

Personality: Emi is highly energetic, cheerful, and always has a smile on her face. She loves to joke around and is known for her sense of humor, even in serious situations. However, she’s also deeply empathetic.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Late twenties to early thirties
Height: 169 cm (5'6½")
Hair Color: Green
Eye Color: Orange
General Appearance: Emi has shoulder-length green hair and bright orange eyes. She has a fit and athletic build, reflecting her active lifestyle as a pro hero. Her expressions are usually lively and animated, matching her upbeat personality.

Hero Outfit: Emi’s hero costume is a bright orange and white jumpsuit with blue accents, designed to be eye-catching.
Civilian Clothes: Emi’s civilian clothes are casual and comfortable, often featuring bright colors and quirky patterns.

entries.name: Camie Utsushimi
entries.content:
Quirk: Glamour - Camie can create illusions that affect all five senses, allowing her to deceive and confuse her opponents. The illusions can take any form she desires but are limited by her imagination and focus.

Personality: Camie is laid-back, friendly, and somewhat air-headed, often speaking in a casual, slang-filled manner. She’s very sociable and enjoys hanging out with friends, though she can be a bit scatterbrained at times.

Real Age: 17-18
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 164 cm (5'5")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Dark brown
General Appearance: Camie has long, straight blonde hair that she often wears in a high ponytail, with a few loose strands framing her face. Her eyes are dark brown and slightly droopy, giving her a relaxed, easy-going appearance. She has a slim and attractive build, which she uses to her advantage when creating illusions.

Hero Outfit: Camie’s hero costume is a black, skin-tight bodysuit with gold accents, designed to be sleek and stylish. It includes a high collar and gloves, along with a belt.
Civilian Clothes: Camie prefers trendy, fashionable clothing, often wearing crop tops, shorts, and high boots. She enjoys accessorizing with jewelry, sunglasses.

entries.name: Kashiko Sekigai
entries.content:
Quirk: Chart: Kashiko's Quirk allows her to create a holographic map of the surrounding area.
 
Personality: Kashiko is highly intelligent, calculating, and a bit haughty. However, she’s also very observant and analytical, able to assess situations quickly and act accordingly.

Real Age: 17-18
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: Light Blue
Eye Color: Grey
General Appearance: Kashiko has shoulder-length, straight light blue hair and sharp grey eyes that give her a piercing, analytical gaze. She has a slim build and carries herself with confidence and poise.

Hero Outfit: Her hero costume consists of a navy blue skin-tight turtleneck bodysuit with two thick bluish-white lines running parallel down her torso. She wears her hair clipped back with a clasp. She has thigh-high boots and high heels.
Civilian Clothes: Kashiko’s civilian wardrobe is smart and sophisticated, often featuring blazers, skirts, and blouses. She prefers clothes that are both stylish and functional, favoring neutral colors and clean lines.

entries.name: Saiko Intelli
entries.content:
Quirk: IQ - Saiko can temporarily increase her intelligence to superhuman levels by drinking tea. The effect varies depending on the type of tea she drinks, allowing her to process information, analyze situations, and develop strategies at an incredible speed.

Personality: Saiko is highly intelligent, and somewhat condescending, often looking down on others who she perceives as less intelligent. She is very confident in her abilities and tends to be a meticulous planner. However, her pride can also be a weakness, as she tends to underestimate others.
 
Real Age: 17-18
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: Periwinkle
Eye Color: Bluish-lavender
General Appearance: Saiko is a rather pale girl of reasonable height, with thin eyes, their irises a bluish-lilac color. Her hair is straight and reaches down to her waist, with two ear-length clumps and a neat fringe framing her face in a hime cut.

School Uniform: Saiko wears a blazer, skirt, and tie, all in the academy’s colors. She accessorizes her uniform with a monocle, which she often adjusts while thinking or strategizing.
Civilian Clothes: Outside of school, Saiko prefers elegant and refined clothing, often wearing dresses or blouses with skirts, reflecting her sophisticated and serious personality.

entries.name: Komari Ikoma
entries.content:
Occupation: School Teacher at Masegaki Primary School - Komari is a dedicated and caring primary school teacher. She works hard for her students.

Personality: Komari is usually always in distress because of her students' behavior, and is constantly seen struggling to control them. However, after seeing her students behaving differently at the Provisional Hero License Course, she was inspired to not give up.

Real Age: Early 30s
Perceived Age: Late 30s
Height: 157 cm (5'2")
Hair Color: Brown
Eye Color: Brown
General Appearance: Komari has a soft and gentle appearance. She has large, navy blue eyes, usually seen tearing up due to her easily-distressed personality. She has a petite and somewhat motherly figure, adding to her nurturing aura.

Work Attire: As a primary school teacher, Komari wears professional yet comfortable clothing, often opting for modest dresses or skirts paired with cardigans or blouses. She favors light, cheerful colors and simple patterns.
Casual Clothes: In her free time, Komari’s style is casual and relaxed. She might wear jeans or comfortable slacks paired with a nice top, enjoying the freedom to dress down when not at work.

entries.name: Mirko
entries.content:
Quirk: Rabbit - Mirko has the physical abilities of a rabbit, including enhanced strength, speed, agility, and extraordinary leg power. Her Quirk also grants her heightened senses and strong ears, which she can use to detect sounds over long distances.
Personality: Mirko is fierce, independent, and confident. She has a strong, unyielding will and prefers to act alone, often rushing into battle with incredible bravery and determination.

Real Age: 26
Perceived Age: Mid-twenties
Height: 159 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: White
Eye Color: Red
General Appearance: Mirko is a muscular and athletic woman, with a powerful build that reflects her physical prowess. She has long white hair that falls down her back. Her large red eyes are sharp and intense. She also has long rabbit-like ears on top of her head, further emphasizing her Quirk.

Hero Outfit: Mirko’s hero costume is a white, sleeveless leotard with a gold crescent moon on her chest. She wears blue thigh-high boots and matching arm guards, along with a belt featuring a fluffy tail.
Civilian Clothes: Mirko’s civilian clothing is casual and practical, often consisting of workout gear or comfortable street clothes. She prefers clothing that allows her to move freely.

entries.name: Ryukyu
entries.content:
Quirk: Dragon - Ryukyu can transform into a large dragon, gaining immense strength, durability, flight, and powerful dragon-like abilities.
Personality: Ryukyu is calm, kind, and responsible. She cares deeply about those around her, particularly her sidekicks and the young heroes she mentors. Despite her dragon-like abilities, Ryukyu is humble.

Real Age: 26
Perceived Age: Mid-twenties
Height: 166 cm (5'5")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Yellow
General Appearance: Ryukyu has a composed appearance, with chin-length blonde hair, which she wears swept back with a headband, a long fringe over the right side of her face, covering her eye. Her yellow inward-tilting eyes with slit pupils and notably sharp teeth. She has a strong yet feminine build and several ear piercings.

Hero Outfit: Ryukyu’s hero costume consists of a dark red, traditional qipao with a pale green scale trim around her shoulders, which seems to only be slit on the left side,
Civilian Clothes: Ryukyu’s civilian wardrobe is elegant and sophisticated, often featuring tailored dresses or suits. Even in her casual wear, Ryukyu maintains a polished and professional look.

entries.name: Mt. Lady
entries.content:
Quirk: Gigantification - Mt. Lady can grow to a gigantic size. Her Quirk makes her a formidable force in battle, but it also requires careful control to avoid causing unnecessary damage.
Personality: Mt. Lady is confident, flirtatious, and enjoys being in the spotlight. She’s aware of her beauty and doesn’t hesitate to use it to her advantage, often indulging in media attention and adoration from fans.

Real Age: 22
Perceived Age: Early twenties
Height: 162 cm (5'4") (Normal size)
Gigantified Height: 20 meters (65.6 feet)
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Purple
General Appearance: Mt. Lady has a voluptuous figure and striking good looks, with long blonde hair that cascades down her back. She maintains a fit and toned physique, which she takes pride in, especially when using her Quirk.

Hero Outfit: Mt. Lady’s hero costume is a skintight bodysuit with purple and white colors, designed to stretch and accommodate her Quirk’s growth. The suit has thigh-high boots, and a horned mask.
Civilian Clothes: Mt. Lady’s civilian clothing is a fashionable outfit that shows off her figure, such as fitted dresses or high-waisted jeans with crop tops.

entries.name: Uwabami
entries.content:
Quirk: Serpentress - Uwabami has three snakes that extend from her head, which she can control at will. These snakes are highly sensitive to smells, allowing Uwabami to track people.
Personality: Uwabami is glamorous and confident, and enjoys being in the public eye. As a celebrity hero. Uwabami is very self-assured and often uses her beauty and charm to her advantage, but she’s also serious about her hero work.

Real Age: 29
Perceived Age: Late twenties
Height: 169 cm (5'7")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Purple
General Appearance: Uwabami is tall and statuesque, with long, flowing blonde hair and striking purple eyes. Her beauty is well-known, and she carries herself with elegance and poise.

Hero Outfit: Uwabami’s costume is a form-fitting, glamorous outfit designed to enhance her natural beauty while providing functionality. The costume is white and gold, with a snake-themed design that complements her Quirk.
Civilian Clothes: Uwabami’s civilian clothing is high fashion, often featuring designer dresses, heels, and luxurious accessories. She enjoys dressing up and is frequently seen in elegant gowns or chic, fashionable outfits.

entries.name: Clair Voyance
entries.content:
Quirk: Voyance- Clair's Quirk gives her x-ray vision, allowing her to see through anything in her line of sight, except for living things.
Personality: Clair Voyance is calm, collected, and highly analytical. She approaches situations with a clear mind and an almost preternatural understanding of what’s to come.

Real Age: 28
Perceived Age: Late twenties
Height: 165 cm (5'5")
Hair Color: Blonde (Brown roots)
Eye Color: Light Blue (Red using her quirk)
General Appearance: Clair Voyance has a striking appearance, with pale blue eyes that seem to glow red with the power of her Quirk. She has a slender build and carries herself with a graceful yet commanding presence.

Hero Outfit: Clair Voyance’s hero costume is a futuristic, streamlined suit designed to enhance her mobility and mental focus. The suit is primarily white with silver accents, featuring a high collar and a sleek visor that covers her eyes when she activates her Quirk.
Civilian Clothes: In civilian life, Clair Voyance prefers elegant, minimalist fashion. She often wears tailored suits or dresses in neutral colors, with subtle accessories that reflect her refined taste.

entries.name: Cow Lady
entries.content:
Quirk: Oxen - Cow Lady's Quirk grants her the ability to transform into a minotaur-like creature, drastically increasing her strength.
Personality: Cow Lady is strong, dependable, and has a warm, nurturing personality. She’s known for her strength in combat, but also for her kindness and willingness to help those in need.

Real Age: 34
Perceived Age: Early twenties
Height: 172cm (5'7¾")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Cow Lady is a tall woman with shoulder-length, wavy blonde hair, two thick, curling horns emerging from the sides of her head, and the long, pointed ears of a cow. Her physical appearance is both strong and maternal.

Hero Outfit: She wears a cowgirl outfit as her hero costume, with a dark orange cropped top, laced and tied together at the bottom, over which she has a sleeveless denim jacket with a short rope tied at her neck.
Civilian Clothes: Cow Lady’s civilian attire is casual and comfortable, often consisting of jeans, boots, and plaid shirts. She prefers practical clothing that allows her to move freely, reflecting her down-to-earth personality. Her style is simple and unpretentious, much like her approach to life and hero work.

entries.name: Ragdoll
entries.content:
Quirk: Search - Ragdoll can monitor and locate up to 100 people at once, knowing their exact locations and weaknesses.
Personality: Ragdoll is bubbly, cheerful, and full of energy. She’s incredibly friendly and outgoing, always eager to help others and spread positivity.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Late twenties
Height: 166cm (5'5¼")
Hair Color: Emerald
Eye Color: Yellow
General Appearance: Ragdoll has long, spiky emerald hair and bright yellow eyes that match her energetic personality. She has a petite build and is often seen with a wide smile on her face, radiating positivity and enthusiasm. Her lively expressions and quick movements make her a dynamic presence in any situation.

Hero Outfit: Ragdoll’s hero costume is also cat-themed, like the rest of her team. Her suit is green and white, with cat ears, a tail, and paw-like gloves. The costume is designed to be both cute and functional.
Civilian Clothes: Ragdoll’s civilian wardrobe is just as playful as her personality. She enjoys wearing colorful, quirky clothing that reflects her fun-loving nature.

entries.name: Pixie-Bob
entries.content:
Quirk: Earth Flow - Pixie-Bob can manipulate the earth, creating various shapes and structures from the ground.
Personality: Pixie-Bob is energetic, passionate, and sometimes a bit eccentric. She’s enthusiastic about her work as a hero and enjoys training younger heroes, often pushing them to their limits.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Late twenties
Height: 167 cm (5'6")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Pixie-Bob has short, wavy blonde hair and bright blue eyes that are full of energy. She has a lively and vibrant appearance, often smiling or expressing her enthusiasm with animated gestures.

Hero Outfit: Pixie-Bob’s hero costume is similar to Mandalay’s, with a cat-themed design. Her suit is primarily blue and white, with cat ears, a tail, and claw-like gloves.
Civilian Clothes: Pixie-Bob’s civilian attire is fun and trendy, often featuring bright colors and playful patterns. She’s not afraid to experiment with different styles, making her wardrobe as lively as her personality.

entries.name: Mandalay
entries.content:
Quirk: Telepath - Mandalay can send telepathic messages to others within a certain range, allowing her to communicate silently and coordinate actions in combat or emergency situations.
Personality: Mandalay is calm, composed, and nurturing. As the leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats, she takes her responsibilities seriously and often acts as the voice of reason within the group.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Late twenties to early thirties
Height: 167 cm (5'6")
Hair Color: Reddish-brown
Eye Color: Green
General Appearance: Mandalay has short, reddish-brown hair styled into three bangs going across her face. She has a slim, athletic build, typical of a seasoned pro hero.

Hero Outfit: Mandalay’s hero costume is a cat-themed bodysuit with a red and yellow color scheme. The suit includes a tail, cat ears, and paw-shaped gloves.
Civilian Clothes: Mandalay’s civilian clothes are casual and comfortable, though, in her civilian attire, she maintains a sense of style with subtle accessories and neat grooming.

entries.name: Star and Stripe
entries.content:
Quirk: New Order - Star and Stripe can impose a rule on a target by touching it and stating the rule, effectively altering the properties of the target according to her will.
Personality: Star and Stripe is brave, patriotic, and fiercely dedicated to justice. As the No. 1 hero in the United States, she embodies the ideals of heroism and freedom.

Real Age: 30
Perceived Age: Late twenties to early thirties
Height: 193 cm (6'4")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Star and Stripe is a tall and imposing woman with a muscular build that reflects her strength and combat abilities. Her appearance is reminiscent of a superhero from classic American comics, with a strong, heroic presence that commands respect.

Hero Outfit: Star and Stripe’s hero costume is heavily influenced by the American flag, with a red, white, and blue color scheme. The suit is armored and designed for battle, symbolizing her role as America’s No. 1 hero.
Civilian Clothes: When not in her hero outfit, Star and Stripe prefers practical and comfortable clothing, often opting for military-style apparel. She might wear cargo pants, boots, and a simple t-shirt or tank top.

entries.name: Lady Nagant
entries.content:
Quirk: Rifle - Lady Nagant’s Quirk allows her to transform her right arm into a rifle, with her hair serving as the bullets. She can control the trajectory and speed of the bullets, making her an incredibly accurate and deadly marksman.
Personality: Lady Nagant is complex, with a mix of cynicism and a sense of justice that has been twisted by her experiences. Once a pro hero, she became disillusioned with the hero society and eventually turned to villainy. Despite this, she retains a strong moral code and a deep understanding of the darker sides of heroism.

Real Age: 31
Perceived Age: Early thirties
Height: 171cm (5'7¼")
Hair Color: Pink and Indigo
Eye Color: Purple
General Appearance: Lady Nagant has a tall and athletic build, with short but flowing purple hair that she often ties into a ponytail.

Hero/Villain Outfit: Lady Nagant’s outfit is a tactical suit designed for stealth and combat. The suit is dark-colored, with various compartments for her tools and ammunition.
Civilian Clothes: In civilian life, Lady Nagant opts for inconspicuous and practical clothing, often choosing outfits that allow her to blend into a crowd. She might wear simple jeans, hoodies, and jackets that help her maintain a low profile.

entries.name: Nana Shimura
entries.content:
Quirk: Float - Nana’s Quirk allows her to suspend herself in mid-air, essentially giving her the ability to fly.
Personality: Nana Shimura was a kind-hearted, brave, and selfless hero who dedicated her life to protecting others. Despite the challenges she faced, Nana always maintained a positive outlook and encouraged others to smile in the face of adversity.

Real Age: 30 (was likely in her 30s at the time of death) 
Perceived Age: Early thirties
Height: 170 cm (5'7")
Hair Color: Black
Eye Color: Purple
General Appearance: Nana Shimura was a tall and athletic woman with a strong, heroic presence. Her hair was dark and straight, kept shoulder-length, and was usually styled in a half-up-half-down bun.

Hero Outfit: Nana’s hero costume was a classic, caped outfit with a red, yellow, and blue color scheme. Her cape and gloves were iconic elements of her costume, symbolizing her status as a powerful and respected hero.
Civilian Clothes: Nana’s civilian style was simple and casual, often featuring comfortable clothing like jeans and t-shirts. She wasn’t one to fuss over fashion, preferring practical attire that suited her active lifestyle.

entries.name: Bubble Girl
entries.content:
Quirk: Bubble - Bubble Girl can produce bubbles filled with an aroma that varies depending on her choice.
Personality: Bubble Girl is cheerful, hardworking, and somewhat quirky. She has a positive attitude and is always eager to help, often going above and beyond in her duties as a sidekick.

Real Age: 21
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 167 cm (5'6")
Hair Color: Blue
Eye Color: Yellow
General Appearance: Kaoruko is a fairly well-built young woman with a rather slim build; her skin is light blue in color. She has short, ruffled dark blue hair that curves upwards and downwards around her head, parted to her right, and wide yellow eyes with thick eyelashes.

Hero Outfit: Her hero costume consists of a skintight dark blue crop top with a white high-collared section over the higher part of her chest, which reveals her torso from the underside of her breasts. She wears black tights with loose white shorts and thick white boots. Over her entire face, she wears a transparent visor. 
Civilian Clothes: Bubble Girl’s civilian clothing is fun and trendy, often featuring bright colors and playful patterns. She enjoys wearing outfits that reflect her energetic personality, such as colorful dresses, skirts, and fun accessories.

entries.name: Sirius
entries.content:
Quirk: Good Ear - Sirius has the ability to hear incredibly faint sounds and detect minute vibrations in the air, giving her enhanced auditory perception.
Personality: Sirius is loyal, diligent, and highly observant. As a sidekick to Selkie, she takes her role seriously and is always focused on the task at hand.

Real Age: 19
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 165 cm (5'5")
Hair Color: Sky Blue
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Sirius is petite and agile, with a slender build that complements her Quirk. Sirius is a young woman with smart blue eyes, sloping inwards, and short, shoulder-length hair of a lighter blue color which she wears side swept to the right.

Hero Outfit: Sirius’s hero costume is a naval-inspired outfit, reflecting her role as Selkie’s sidekick. The suit is white and blue, with a sailor collar and a matching cap.
Civilian Clothes: In civilian life, Sirius favors practical and comfortable clothing, often opting for casual nautical-themed attire, such as striped shirts, shorts, and deck shoes.

entries.name: Burnin
entries.content:
Quirk: Blazing Hair - Burnin can ignite her hair into intense green flames that she can manipulate at will. Her Quirk also grants her a high resistance to heat and fire.
Personality: Moe possesses a burning hot personality. She is very enthusiastic and her fiery personality tends to clash a lot.

Real Age: 25
Perceived Age: Early twenties
Height: 169cm (5'6½")
Hair Color: Green (Flaming)
Eye Color: Red-orange
General Appearance: Burnin has a striking appearance, with wild green hair that she can ignite into flames. Her red eyes and sharp teeth full of energy. Burnin has an athletic build, and her overall look is intense and dynamic, much like her approach to hero work.

Hero Outfit: Burnin’s hero costume is a sleek, fire-resistant suit that allows her to fully utilize her Quirk. The outfit includes reinforced gloves and boots for combat. The suit is designed to withstand extreme heat.
Civilian Clothes: Burnin’s civilian attire is casual and edgy, often featuring streetwear styles like leather jackets, ripped jeans, and graphic tees. She likes to dress in a way that reflects her bold personality, often choosing clothes that are both stylish and practical.

entries.name: Himiko Toga
entries.content:
Quirk: Transform - Himiko Toga’s Quirk allows her to transform into a physical copy of another person by ingesting their blood.
Personality: Himiko Toga is cheerful, bubbly, and disturbingly obsessed with blood and the people she admires. Despite her seemingly sweet and innocent demeanor, she has a twisted, violent nature and enjoys causing chaos and harm. Toga is deeply fascinated by the concept of love and expresses this in dangerous and unhealthy ways.

Real Age: 17
Perceived Age: Mid to late teens
Height: 157 cm (5'2")
Hair Color: Ash Blonde
Eye Color: Yellow
General Appearance: Himiko Toga has a petite build with ash blonde hair styled into two messy buns. Her yellow eyes have a cat-like appearance, often wide and filled with a manic glee. Her appearance is cute yet unsettling, perfectly embodying her twisted personality.

Villain Outfit: Toga’s villain costume is a schoolgirl uniform with a beige cardigan, a navy skirt, and a red necktie.
Civilian Clothes: In her civilian life, Toga prefers cute and girlish outfits. Her clothing choices usually reflect her desire to appear as a typical, sweet teenage girl, hiding her more dangerous nature behind an innocent facade.

entries.name: Slice
entries.content:
Quirk: Sharp Force - Slice can extend and manipulate the length, sharpness, and hardness of her hair, turning it into a blade.
Personality: Slice is cold, ruthless, and highly focused on her goals. She has a sharp mind and is known for her efficiency in battle, never hesitating to eliminate anyone who stands in her way. She’s not one for unnecessary chatter and her loyalty lies with her cause.

Real Age: 23
Perceived Age: Early twenties
Height: 163cm (5'4")
Hair Color: Crimson Red
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Slice has a striking appearance with long, crimson red hair that she often keeps partially tied back, with some sections left loose to use in combat. She has a slender yet toned physique.

Villain Outfit: Kiruka wears a pale purple blouse with frilled cuffs; the collar upturned, and a pearl string necklace of a similar color. Over this is a short, navy blue dress with a collar so low it dips down to her waist and a thick brown belt around her waist. She also wears a pair of black boots and a black choker with a small red circle in the center.
Civilian Clothes: In civilian life, Slice opts for understated, practical clothing, usually in dark colors. Her civilian style is minimalistic.

entries.name: Curious
entries.content:
Quirk: Landmine - Curious can turn anything she touches into an explosive by imbuing it with kinetic energy.
Personality: Curious is ambitious, inquisitive, and has a relentless drive to uncover the truth and share it with the world. She’s a journalist at heart, always seeking to expose hidden stories and bring light to the darkness of society.

Real Age: 28
Perceived Age: Late twenties
Height: 168 cm (5'6")
Hair Color: Lilac
Skin Color: Pale blue
Eye Color: Green irises, black sclerae
General Appearance: Chitose was a woman with long, pale lilac hair, worn parted to her right side, full lips and pale blue skin. Her eyes were unusual, in that her sclerae were completely black whereas her eye irises were green, and her pupils were completely black.

Villain Outfit: She wore gold earrings, a navy blue, shoulderless dress with long sleeves and a belt around her waist. She sported light-colored laced high boots.
Civilian Clothes: In civilian life, Curious dresses in sharp, professional attire, such as blouses, pencil skirts, and blazers. Her style is elegant and business-like, reflecting her role as a journalist. She always appears well-put-together.

entries.name: Mitsuki Bakugo
entries.content:
Quirk: Glycerin - Mitsuki’s Quirk allows her to secrete glycerin from her skin, which keeps her skin moisturized and youthful-looking. Unlike her son, Katsuki, her Quirk doesn’t have any explosive properties.
Personality: Mitsuki is fiery, outspoken, and blunt, much like her son. She has a strong-willed personality and doesn’t shy away from speaking her mind, especially when it comes to her son’s behavior. However, she also shows a more tender side, particularly when it comes to her husband and son, showing that her harshness comes from a place of love.

Real Age: 43
Perceived Age: Early to mid 30s (due to her Quirk)
Height: 170 cm (5'7")
Hair Color: Ash Blonde
Eye Color: Red
General Appearance: Mitsuki has a striking appearance with short, spiky ash blonde hair and sharp red eyes. She has a youthful complexion, thanks to her Quirk, and a slim, toned build. Mitsuki often has a confident, assertive expression.

Civilian Clothes: Mitsuki’s style is bold and fashionable, often wearing trendy outfits that complement her youthful appearance. She prefers clothes that are both stylish and comfortable, such as fitted jeans, blouses, and fashionable jackets.

entries.name: Mika Jiro
entries.content:
Quirk: Earphone Jack - Mika's Quirk gives her a pair of headphone jacks hanging from her earlobes. Assuming that her Quirk is the same as her daughter's, she can plug the jacks into objects and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them.
Personality: Mika Jiro is warm, supportive, and kind. She has a gentle and nurturing personality, always encouraging her daughter’s musical talents while also supporting her journey as a hero.

Real Age: 36
Perceived Age: Late 30s
Height: 159 cm (5'2½")
Hair Color: Dark Purple
Eye Color: Black
General Appearance: Mika is a slender woman who wears glasses with black frames. Her hair is straight, short, and dark purple in color, with bangs that fall to the right side of her face. In every instance where she has made an appearance thus far, she is shown wearing a collared shell top, a pencil skirt, and tights.

Civilian Clothes: Mika’s clothing style is casual and elegant, often featuring simple yet stylish outfits such as long skirts, blouses, and cardigans. She prefers soft, earthy tones and comfortable fabrics, reflecting her practical yet refined taste.

entries.name: Rei Todoroki
entries.content:
Quirk: Frost - Rei’s Quirk allows her to generate and control ice.
Personality: Rei Todoroki is a gentle and caring woman, but she has suffered greatly due to her marriage to Endeavor. The strain of her life led to a mental breakdown. Rei deeply loves her children. She is soft-spoken and reserved.

Real Age: 43
Perceived Age: late 40s (due to stress)
Height: 170 cm (5'7")
Hair Color: White
Eye Color: Gray
General Appearance: Rei has a delicate and fragile appearance, with long white hair that she often wears loose. Her gray eyes are soft and melancholic. Rei has a slender build and a pale complexion, often appearing somewhat ethereal.

Civilian Clothes: Rei’s clothing style is simple and modest, often consisting of long dresses, cardigans, and other comfortable, loose-fitting garments. She favors soft colors like pastels and whites, reflecting her gentle and reserved nature.

entries.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
entries.content:
Quirk: Fuyumi inherited her mother's ability to generate ice.
Personality: Fuyumi is compassionate, responsible, and caring. She has taken on a maternal role within the Todoroki family, especially after the turmoil caused by her father, Endeavor, and the absence of her mother. Fuyumi is dedicated to keeping the family together and often acts as a mediator between her siblings and their father.

Real Age: 23
Perceived Age: Early 20s
Height: 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: White with Red Highlights
Eye Color: Turquoise
General Appearance: Fuyumi has a soft and gentle appearance, with white hair that has a few red streaks, hinting at her father’s influence. Her turquoise eyes are warm and kind, often filled with concern for her family.

Civilian Clothes: Fuyumi’s style is simple and modest, often consisting of feminine and professional outfits such as blouses, skirts, and dresses.

entries.name: Melissa Shield
entries.content:
Quirk: None but she is an exceptionally talented inventor and scientist. Her intellect and engineering skills allow her to create advanced technology and support equipment for heroes.
Personality: Melissa is kind-hearted, intelligent, and determined. Despite not having a Quirk, she’s driven to help others and make a difference in the world, much like her father, David Shield.

Real Age: 17
Perceived Age: Late teens
Height: 160 cm (5'3")
Hair Color: Blonde
Eye Color: Blue
General Appearance: Melissa has a bright and cheerful appearance with long blonde hair. Her blue eyes are full of warmth and optimism. She has a slender build and a youthful, energetic demeanor, always carrying herself with a sense of purpose and enthusiasm.

Civilian Clothes: Melissa’s clothing style is casual and practical, often consisting of comfortable outfits like t-shirts, jeans, and sneakers. Her style is unpretentious and functional, reflecting her down-to-earth personality.

entries.name: U.A. Highschool
entries.content:
U.A. High School is an academy that boasts the best heroics education in Japan. It sits atop a forested hill that overlooks Musutafu.
It is one of the primary settings in which the story takes place.

entries.name: Musutafu, Japan
entries.content: Musutafu, Japan is the city where My Hero Academia takes place. It is located somewhere in Shizuoka Prefecture.

entries.name: Sports Festival Stadium
entries.content: The Sports Festival Stadium is the stadium where the U.A. Sports Festival takes place. It's located inside the U.A. High School campus.

entries.name: Unforeseen Simulation Joint
entries.content: Unforeseen Simulation Joint, often abbreviated as U.S.J., is a training facility located in U.A. High School. Its purpose is to train Hero students for disaster rescue.

entries.name: Ground Beta
entries.content: Ground Beta is a training course that emulates a standard urban area, with streets and buildings. Several of its buildings also contain monitoring rooms in their basements, where indoor exercises can be observed.

entries.name: Gym Gamma
entries.content: Gym Gamma consists of a large, empty, and enclosed space. It is entirely made of concrete, which is capable of adjusting to suit the personal needs of who is using the gym.

entries.name: Recovery Girl's Nurse's Office
entries.content: Is an infirmary located in U.A. High School. It is maintained by Recovery Girl. The interior of the office has a work desk for Recovery Girl, including a computer and a drawer with unspecified medicine next to it. It also has two beds as well as two chairs.

entries.name: Class 1-A
entries.content: Is the homeroom class of Class 1-A

entries.name: Class 1-B
entries.content: Is the homeroom class of Class 1-B

entries.name: Class 1-H
entries.content: Is the homeroom class of the support course students
